# Ed Technolog

> Ed Technolog builds lightweight tools that help schools and teachers plan lessons, track student progress, and run online learning without wrestling with complicated systems. Less admin, more teaching: three simple tools that a new teacher can learn in an afternoon, designed with classroom teachers and used by small and mid-sized schools across North America.

The three tools share one account and one roster:

- PlanBoard: a drag-and-drop lesson planner for building weekly and unit plans, aligning them to standards and sharing them with colleagues.
- A student progress tracker (called Markbook on some pages and ProgressTrack on others): turns grades, quiz results and teacher notes into a clear picture of each student, with mastery-based and percentage grading and parent-friendly progress summaries.
- An online classroom (called Classroom Loop on some pages and ClassLink Online on others): assignments, discussions and short live sessions, designed to work on older school laptops and slow connections, with a low-bandwidth mode.

Pricing is per school. All plans include a 30-day trial and no setup fee. Ed Technolog serves public elementary and middle schools, independent and private schools, charter school networks, and tutoring centers and after-school programs. The company was started in 2019 by two former teachers and is based in Madison, Wisconsin.
